description:
The Department of Veterans Affairs intends to award a sole source purchase order to Scintica, Inc. for a 
3D Bioprinter which is an integral component of a VA research project being conducted by the Iowa City VA Healthcare System Research Department.

The NAICS code is 334516 and the size standard is 1000 employees. The PSC is 6515.
HOW TO RESPOND:
All responses must have the VA Identifier: 36C26326Q0448 in the subject line of the email.
All responses must be received no later than: 05:00pm Central Time, Thursday March 19, 2026.
All responses must be submitted to this email address:  Joseph.Bennett@va.gov

See attached:  36C26326Q0448   INTENT TO SOLE SOURCE DESCRIPTION AND INSTRUCTIONS
